title: Ad accounts
subtitle: Your Business Center accounts and the users you invite.

noBc.title: Connect your TikTok Business Center
noBc.body: Connect it on the Funding page and all its ad accounts will show up here, ready to invite.

accounts.maxBatch: You can invite up to {{max}} accounts at a time. Only the first {{max}} were selected.
accounts.unlinkBody: The user keeps all their data and their workspace. They lose the agency's TikTok login for this ad account, and you stop seeing its campaign numbers. You can invite them again later.

invite.title: Invite links ready
invite.intro: Send each link to the ad account's owner. These links are shown only now, so copy or share them before you close this window.
invite.note: Each link works once and expires in 30 days. Re-inviting an account replaces its old link. After accepting, you will see campaign numbers only: spend, clicks, chats, qualified leads, orders and revenue. Never their messages, phone numbers or lead details.
invite.message: {{agency}} invited you to manage your ad account on WOB. Open this link to accept: {{url}}

perf.privacy: You see campaign numbers only. Chats, phone numbers and lead details stay private to each user.
perf.emptyBody: Ad accounts appear here after their owners accept your invite. Invite them from the Accounts tab.
perf.noCampaigns: No campaign data for this period.

join.invalidTitle: This invite link is no longer valid
join.invalidBody: It may have been used, revoked or expired. Ask the agency to send you a new link.
join.title: {{agency}} invited you to manage {{account}} on WOB
join.titleNoName: {{agency}} invited you to link an ad account on WOB
canSeeList: Campaign numbers: spend, clicks, number of chats
join.funds: The agency funds this ad account from its own Business Center, and you don't need to connect TikTok yourself.
join.leave: You can leave the agency at any time, and your data stays with you.
join.accept: Accept and link my ad account
join.noClientBody: This is an agency workspace. To accept an invite, sign in with (or create) an individual account for the business that owns the ad account.

errors.invite_invalid: This invite link is no longer valid. Ask the agency for a new one.
errors.own_agency: You can't accept an invite from your own agency.
errors.already_linked: This ad account is already linked to an agency.
errors.limit: Your plan's ad account limit has been reached.

managed.hint: {{agency}} funds this ad account and sees its campaign numbers only.
managed.leaveBody: The agency's access stops at once. Your data stays with you, and you can connect your own TikTok account afterwards.

linked.sectionDesc: Users who joined WOB and linked their ad account to you. You see campaign numbers only.
linked.subtitle: Campaign numbers for the last 7 days. Chats and lead details stay private to the user.
linked.notFound: This linked account isn't available. The user may have disconnected from you.
linked.indexHint: You have no clients of your own yet. Your linked users are in the agency overview.
